symptom: `show references to` an entity, attribute or association never listed a message definition that exposes it (EvoraICX: EvoraCore.MD_ResolutionStep exposes InvestigationTask and its 15 attributes, 0 edges), so renaming or deleting one looked safe.
cause: memberRefSourceTypes, the closed list of unit types the raw member-ref walk visits, had the two mapping types but neither message-definition type, although a message definition stores its Entity/Attribute/Association by qualified name exactly as a mapping does.
insight: When a document type stores members by qualified name, the raw walk needs only a row in memberRefSourceTypes (plus the entity case alongside the mappings); no per-type extractor. List the document types the gen package registers RefByName props for (codec.DefaultRefRegistry) and diff against memberRefSourceTypes to find the next gap. TestSkillDocumentsRealRefObjectTypes checks only that documented values exist, not that every source type is documented, so the lint-rule doc must be updated by hand.
